name: Masters in Mathematics at The Open University

mentions.name: Masters in Mathematics at The Open University
mentions.description: This masters degree program in Mathematics from The Open University is pursued to gain deep knowledge of obscure and arguably-useless math.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started a masters in Mathematics from The Open University at the beginning of October.  I've wanted to really get into the weeds of obscure and arguably-useless math for about as long as I can remember, and I figure that getting a masters in it is as good a way to get that knowledge as any way else.
